answer.book: Casaubon's 1590 edition of Aristotle's Opera (Greek text with Latin translations and commentary), a multi-work volume in which each treatise has its own books and chapters. This sheet (scans 299-542) covers De caelo, Meteorologica, De anima, De sensu, De memoria, De motu animalium and Historia animalium, and does not continue the Analytica priora chapters in the outline; the entries below cover only the De caelo chapters at the start of the sheet.
